import json

from security_client import get_secrets_client


def parse_json_secret(payload, config=None):
    client = get_secrets_client(config)
    response = client.get_secret_value(SecretId=payload["secret_id"])
    value = response["SecretString"] if "SecretString" in response else response["SecretBinary"].decode("utf-8")
    parsed_value = json.loads(value)
    return parsed_value

import re

from security_client import get_secrets_client


def secret_label_safety(payload, config=None):
    client = get_secrets_client(config)
    response = client.describe_secret(SecretId=payload["secret_id"])
    labels = response["Name"] + " " + response["Description"]
    unsafe_patterns = ["password", "secret", "key"]
    is_safe = all(pattern not in labels.lower() for pattern in unsafe_patterns)
    return {"is_safe": is_safe}

from security_client import get_secrets_client


def secret_audit_embedding(payload, config=None):
    client = get_secrets_client(config)
    response = client.describe_secret(SecretId=payload["secret_id"])
    notes = response["Description"]
    # Placeholder for actual embedding logic
    embedded_notes = notes.replace(" ", "_")
    return {"embedded_notes": embedded_notes}

from security_client import get_secrets_client


def runbook_translate(payload, config=None):
    client = get_secrets_client(config)
    response = client.describe_secret(SecretId=payload["secret_id"])
    notes = response["Description"]
    # Placeholder for actual translation logic
    translated_notes = notes.upper()
    return {"translated_notes": translated_notes}
